name: Copper
why: Backbone of electrification; largest volume-growth mineral (~7 Mt by 2040, IEA).

name: Lithium
why: Fastest-growing energy mineral; demand >3x by 2040 (IEA STEPS).

name: Semiconductor-grade silicon
why: Base layer of every chip; AI compute pulls demand forward.

name: Iron ore & steel
why: Largest-volume structural metal; green steel reshapes ore mix.

name: Aluminium
why: Lightweighting and grid conductor; CRMA strategic material.

name: NdPr (neodymium/praseodymium)
why: High-performance magnets for EV motors, wind, robots, defense.

name: Ammonia / urea
why: Feeds ~half the world; ammonia also a H₂ carrier candidate.

name: Nickel
why: High-energy cathodes, stainless, superalloys.

name: Graphite
why: Dominant battery anode; ~90%+ anode processing in China.

name: Portland cement / clinker
why: Concrete is the most-used manufactured material; ~7–8% of CO₂.

name: Phosphate rock / phosphoric acid
why: Nutrient with no substitute; Morocco ~70% of reserves; LFP input.

name: Cobalt
why: Cathode and superalloy metal; DRC ~70% supply with export quotas.

name: Uranium (U₃O₈)
why: Fuel for nuclear buildout driven by AI power and energy security.

name: Potash (KCl)
why: Nutrient with no substitute; Russia/Belarus ~40% supply.

name: Dysprosium & terbium
why: Heavy rare earths for high-temp magnets; effectively China-only.

name: Gallium
why: GaN power/RF and GaAs; China ~98% primary supply.

name: Solar-grade polysilicon
why: Feedstock for the largest new power source.

name: Germanium
why: Fiber, IR optics, space solar; Zn by-product under Chinese control.

name: Manganese
why: Essential to steel; growing in LMFP/Mn-rich cathodes.

name: Silver
why: Best conductor; PV and electronics; now on US critical list.

name: Platinum
why: Catalysts and PEM fuel cells; ~70% from South Africa.

name: Helium
why: No substitute in fabs, MRI, rockets.

name: Tungsten
why: Hard metals, armor, chip interconnects; ~80% China.

name: Sulfur / sulfuric acid
why: Hidden input to phosphates, HPAL nickel, copper SX-EW, lithium.

name: Enriched uranium / HALEU
why: Nuclear-fuel bottleneck; Russia large enrichment share.

name: Iridium
why: PEM electrolyzer anode catalyst; few tonnes/year.

name: Tin
why: Solder in all electronics; fragile Myanmar/Indonesia/DRC supply.

name: Antimony
why: Munitions, flame retardants, PV glass; China dominates.

name: Grain-oriented electrical steel
why: Transformer cores are the binding grid constraint.

name: Low-carbon hydrogen
why: Decarbonizes ammonia, refining, steel if costs fall.

name: Fluorspar / HF
why: Fluorine for electrolytes, PVDF, etching, refrigerants.

name: Zinc
why: Galvanizing steel; host for Ga/Ge/In by-products.

name: Titanium
why: Aerospace/defense structural metal; sponge concentrated.

name: Silicon carbide substrates
why: 800V EVs and efficient power electronics.

name: SCMs (slag, fly ash, calcined clay)
why: Fastest way to cut concrete CO₂; supply of slag/ash shrinks.

name: Vanadium
why: HS rebar and flow batteries; China/Russia/SA dominate.

name: Carbon fiber & composites
why: Lightweighting for aircraft, H₂ tanks, drones, wind blades.

name: High-purity quartz
why: Crucibles for every silicon ingot; Spruce Pine single-point risk.

name: LFP cathode
why: Default chemistry for grid storage and mass-market EVs.

name: Ni-rich cathode precursors
why: High-energy chemistries for long-range EVs and aviation.

name: Chlorine & caustic soda
why: Water disinfection, PVC, alumina, chemicals.

name: Molybdenum
why: Alloying for HS steels, superalloys, oil & gas.

name: Niobium
why: Microalloyed steel, superconductors; ~90% Brazil (CBMM).

name: Tantalum
why: Capacitors and superalloys; conflict-supply exposure.

name: Chromium
why: Stainless and superalloys; South Africa dominates.

name: Metallurgical coal
why: Still needed for BF steel through 2040s, esp. India.

name: Electronic specialty gases
why: Chip lithography and etch; 2022 neon shock showed risk.

name: Photoresists & EUV materials
why: Leading-edge lithography; Japan dominates.

name: Hafnium
why: High-k gates, superalloys, nuclear control rods.

name: Magnesium
why: Al alloys, Ti production, lightweighting; China ~85%+.

name: Palladium
why: Auto catalysts and electronics; Russia major supplier.

name: Ruthenium
why: Hard drives, chip interconnect, electrodes.

name: Boron
why: NdFeB magnets, fiberglass, doping, nuclear shielding.

name: Lead
why: Lead-acid batteries, munitions, shielding.

name: Zirconium / zircon
why: Nuclear cladding, ceramics, refractories.

name: Energetic materials
why: Artillery/missile output limited by Western energetics capacity.

name: Indium
why: ITO, InP, solders; zinc by-product.

name: Beryllium
why: Aerospace, defense, X-ray, fusion; US-dominated.

name: Rhenium
why: Single-crystal jet-engine superalloys; mostly Chile.

name: Construction aggregates
why: Largest-volume extracted material; local shortages.

name: Lime
why: Steel refining, water treatment, FGD, carbon-removal sorbent.

name: Polyolefins (PE/PP)
why: Packaging, pipes, cable insulation, medical plastics.

name: Fluoropolymers
why: Battery binders, electrolyzer membranes, fab parts; PFAS squeeze.

name: ABF & packaging substrates
why: AI packaging near-monopoly (Ajinomoto, Nittobo).

name: Glass fiber
why: Wind blades, circuit boards, composites.

name: RO membranes
why: Desalination and reuse for climate resilience.

name: Water-treatment coagulants
why: Basic drinking-water and wastewater treatment.

name: Activated carbon
why: PFAS and micropollutant removal.

name: Ion-exchange resins & DLE sorbents
why: Direct lithium extraction plus water treatment.

name: Needle coke & graphite electrodes
why: Enable EAF steel; feed synthetic graphite.

name: Soda ash
why: PV glass, lithium processing, sodium-ion batteries.

name: Tellurium
why: CdTe thin-film PV; copper by-product.

name: Samarium
why: SmCo magnets for high-temp missiles/aircraft; China-controlled.

name: Yttrium
why: TBCs, lasers, phosphors; China-controlled.

name: Scandium
why: Al-Sc alloys and SOFCs; tiny illiquid market.

name: Bismuth
why: Lead-free solders, medicines; Chinese export control since 2025.

name: Rhodium
why: Auto NOx catalysts and glass-fiber bushings.

name: Lanthanum & cerium
why: Refinery catalysts, polishing, NiMH; by-products of NdPr.

name: Iodine
why: X-ray contrast, disinfectants, polarizing films; Chile/Japan.

name: Medical radioisotopes
why: Imaging and radioligand therapy boom; ageing reactors.

name: Natural rubber
why: Truck/aircraft tires; no full synthetic substitute; SE Asia.

name: Zeolites & carbon-capture sorbents
why: Refining, emissions control, DAC.

name: LiPF₆ & battery electrolytes
why: Every Li-ion cell needs electrolyte.

name: Silicon anode materials
why: Energy-density step-up for next-gen cells.

name: Synthetic diamond
why: Cutting tools, heat spreaders, possible semis.

name: Gadolinium
why: MRI contrast, neutron absorbers, magnet doping.

name: Indium phosphide substrates
why: Lasers for AI data-center optical interconnects.

name: Gold
why: Electronics contacts; price mostly monetary.

name: High-purity alumina
why: LED sapphire, separator coatings, chip parts.

name: REBCO HTS tape
why: Compact fusion magnets, superconducting cables.

name: Solid-state electrolytes
why: Next battery platform if commercialized.

name: Perovskite PV materials
why: Possible tandem-cell efficiency step-change.

name: Erbium & fiber dopants
why: Optical amplifiers for long-haul and AI fiber.

name: Cesium & rubidium
why: Atomic clocks (PNT) and drilling fluids.

name: Engineered / mass timber
why: Low-carbon structural material for mid-rise.

name: Building insulation
why: Efficiency cuts energy demand; heat resilience.

name: Selenium
why: Glass, CIGS PV, animal feed, electronics.

name: Barite
why: Drilling fluids and radiation shielding.

name: Epoxy & thermoset resins
why: Wind blades, composites, boards, coatings.

name: Gypsum
why: Wallboard and cement retarder; FGD supply shrinks as coal retires.
